$comment: P3-S08 O-9 static route classification. content = returns customer content and MUST carry the shared guard; metadata = reviewed, with the reason. Maintained with qa-o9-content-access.int.spec.ts (dynamic audit). A new GET route in the customer-content areas fails the unit gate until it is listed here.

metadata.GET /v1/hosting/sites/:id/files: RBAC, not the content guard: the permission this route needs (hosting:files:read) is granted only to owner, admin and developer (packages/db/migrations/hosting/1993__hosting__site_tools.sql: billing_admin and viewer hold none of the site-tool permissions), so a billing administrator never reaches the content; it is therefore outside the O-9 switch. Reviewed at the Phase 3 reconciliation; if a role with billing_admin plus these permissions is ever created, add @ContentRead.
